title: Ether’s rejected prophecy
summary: Moroni introduces his account of the people’s destruction. Ether’s reported prophecies concern the choice land, two holy cities, their inhabitants, and the new heaven and earth.

explicit_facts.text: Moroni says he will finish his record concerning the destruction of the people.
The people rejected Ether’s words, which included prophecies about the land, Jerusalem, the New Jerusalem, and a new heaven and earth.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Moroni may be shown writing as he introduces his record.
unspecified_visual_details: Moroni’s appearance, writing materials, and surroundings are not described.

narration.text: And now I, Moroni, proceed to finish my record
they rejected all the words of Ether

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The future events in Ether’s prophecies are reported teachings, not events occurring in this scene.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict the New Jerusalem descending as a present event.
Do not depict Christ, angels, or future inhabitants as present.

title: Ether in the rock
summary: After the people cast Ether out, he hides in a rock cavity by day and goes out at night to view what will happen to the people. He makes the remainder of his record there by night.

explicit_facts.text: The people esteemed Ether as nothing and cast him out.
Ether hid in a rock cavity by day, went out by night to view what would come upon the people, and made the remainder of his record in the cavity by night.

reasonable_visual_inferences: A rock cavity may be shown as Ether’s shelter.
unspecified_visual_details: The cavity’s appearance, Ether’s appearance, and his writing materials are unspecified.

narration.text: he hid himself in the cavity of a rock by day
he made the remainder of his record

prohibited_inventions: Do not show the people casting Ether out as a separately staged event; the verse summarizes it.

title: War rises against Coriantumr
summary: A great war begins. Mighty men seek Coriantumr’s destruction through secret plans, and he gives them battle. The account says neither Coriantumr nor the named families’ children repented.

explicit_facts.text: In the year Ether was cast out, a great war began; many mighty men sought to destroy Coriantumr through secret plans.
Coriantumr studied the arts of war and gave battle to those seeking to destroy him.
Coriantumr, his children, the children of Cohor and Corihor, and all the people described did not repent.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Coriantumr and opposing fighters may be shown confronting one another in battle.
unspecified_visual_details: The fighters’ appearance, weapons, and battle location are unspecified.

narration.text: there began to be a great war among the people
he gave battle unto them

doctrinal_or_story_notes: Verse 17 reports lack of repentance; it does not describe a distinct visible event.
prohibited_inventions: Do not invent the secret plans’ details or show them as supernatural.

title: Fighting for the kingdom
summary: In Ether’s first year in the rock cavity, secret combinations fight Coriantumr to obtain the kingdom, and many are slain. Coriantumr’s sons fight and bleed.

explicit_facts.text: Many people were slain by the sword of secret combinations fighting Coriantumr to obtain the kingdom.
Coriantumr’s sons fought and bled much.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Fighters may be shown engaged in combat with swords, without graphic injury.
unspecified_visual_details: The battle’s precise setting and the identities of the slain are unspecified.

narration.text: there were many people who were slain by the sword
the sons of Coriantumr fought much

prohibited_inventions: Do not depict wounds, blood, or severed body parts; show combat without gore.

title: The word of the Lord comes to Ether
summary: In the second year, the word of the Lord comes to Ether, directing him to prophesy to Coriantumr. The message promises that repentance by Coriantumr and his household will spare the people and restore his kingdom; otherwise, it foretells destruction, Coriantumr’s survival, another people receiving the land, and his burial by them.

explicit_facts.text: In the second year, the word of the Lord came to Ether and directed him to prophesy to Coriantumr.
The message says that if Coriantumr and his household repent, the Lord will give him his kingdom and spare the people.
Otherwise, the message foretells destruction for Coriantumr’s household and every soul except Coriantumr.
The message foretells that Coriantumr will live to see prophecies fulfilled concerning another people receiving the land as their inheritance, and that they will bury him.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Ether may be shown alone as the recipient of the message, without showing how it reaches him.
unspecified_visual_details: Ether’s location and surroundings are not stated.
The manner in which the word comes to Ether is not described.

narration.text: And in the second year the word of the Lord came to Ether,
if he would repent, and all his household, the Lord would give unto him his kingdom and spare the people—
another people receiving the land for their inheritance; and Coriantumr should receive a burial by them;
every soul should be destroyed save it were Coriantumr.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The destruction, inheritance, and burial are foretold events, not events occurring in this scene.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict the Lord appearing visibly or invent a manner of communication.
Do not show Ether delivering the prophecy to Coriantumr or depict its future fulfillment.

title: Ether flees back to the rock
summary: Coriantumr, his household, and the people do not repent. War continues, and when people seek to kill Ether, he flees and hides again in the rock cavity.

explicit_facts.text: Coriantumr, his household, and the people did not repent, and the wars continued.
People sought to kill Ether; he fled from them and hid again in the cavity of the rock.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Ether may be shown moving into the rock cavity to hide.
unspecified_visual_details: The pursuers’ number, identity, appearance, and the route to the cavity are unspecified.

narration.text: he fled from before them and hid again

prohibited_inventions: Do not show Ether being caught or injured.

title: Shared brings Coriantumr into captivity
summary: Shared gives battle to Coriantumr and defeats him. In the third year, Shared brings Coriantumr into captivity.

explicit_facts.text: Shared gave battle to Coriantumr and beat him.
In the third year, Shared brought Coriantumr into captivity.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Shared and Coriantumr may be shown in battle.
Coriantumr may be shown captive in a separate, later moment.
unspecified_visual_details: The location, their appearances, and the method of captivity are unspecified.

narration.text: And it came to pass that there arose up Shared, and he also gave battle unto Coriantumr; and he did beat him, insomuch that in the third year he did bring him into captivity.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: Do not merge the battle and the third-year captivity into a single moment.
prohibited_inventions: Do not add dialogue, named forces, or details of Coriantumr’s captivity.

title: Coriantumr’s sons regain the kingdom
summary: In the fourth year, Coriantumr’s sons beat Shared and obtain the kingdom again for their father.

explicit_facts.text: In the fourth year, Coriantumr’s sons beat Shared and obtained the kingdom again for their father.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The sons and Shared may be depicted in the confrontation in which the sons prevail.
unspecified_visual_details: The setting, the sons’ appearances, and how the kingdom was regained are unspecified.

narration.text: the sons of Coriantumr, in the fourth year, did beat Shared, and did obtain the kingdom again unto their father.

prohibited_inventions: Do not depict Coriantumr as present; the verse does not say he is.
Do not invent armies, dialogue, or details of the confrontation.

title: War across the land
summary: War spreads over the land, with each man’s band fighting for what it desires. Robbers and every manner of wickedness are also reported throughout the land.

explicit_facts.text: War covered the land, and every man fought with his band for what he desired.
Robbers and all manner of wickedness were upon the land.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Multiple bands may be shown fighting in a broad view of the land.
unspecified_visual_details: The bands’ identities, appearance, specific motives, and locations are unspecified.

narration.text: every man with his band fighting for that which he desired
there were robbers

prohibited_inventions: Do not assign names or biographies to the unnamed bands or robbers.

title: Battle in the valley of Gilgal
summary: Coriantumr goes against Shared with his armies. They meet in anger and battle in the valley of Gilgal. Shared fights against Coriantumr for three days. Coriantumr defeats Shared and pursues him until Shared reaches the plains of Heshlon.

explicit_facts.text: Coriantumr was exceedingly angry with Shared and went against him with his armies. They met in great anger in the valley of Gilgal, where the battle became exceedingly sore.
Shared fought against Coriantumr for three days. Coriantumr beat and pursued Shared until Shared came to the plains of Heshlon.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The pursuit toward the plains of Heshlon can be shown separately from the fighting in the valley.
unspecified_visual_details: The armies' appearance, terrain details, and combat methods are unspecified.

narration.text: they did meet in the valley of Gilgal
Shared fought against him for the space of three days.
Coriantumr beat him, and did pursue him until he came to the plains of Heshlon.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The fighting spans three days; do not depict it as a single instant.
Shared, not Coriantumr, reaches the plains of Heshlon in the pursuit account.
prohibited_inventions: Do not add dialogue, casualties, battle tactics, or details of Shared's forces not stated in the verses.

title: Shared drives Coriantumr back
summary: Shared battles Coriantumr again on the plains, defeats him, and drives him back to the valley of Gilgal.

explicit_facts.text: Shared gave Coriantumr battle again on the plains.
Shared beat Coriantumr and drove him back to the valley of Gilgal.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Coriantumr may be shown moving back toward the valley of Gilgal as Shared presses the battle.
unspecified_visual_details: The combatants’ appearances, the battle’s duration, and the route to Gilgal are unspecified.

narration.text: Shared gave him battle again upon the plains; and behold, he did beat Coriantumr, and drove him back again to the valley of Gilgal.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The word “again” indicates an earlier battle but does not describe it in this supplied verse.
prohibited_inventions: Do not name the plains or depict an earlier battle.
Do not invent forces, dialogue, injuries, or a specific route.

title: Coriantumr defeats Shared
summary: Coriantumr battles Shared again in the valley of Gilgal, defeats him, and kills him.

explicit_facts.text: Coriantumr gave Shared battle again in the valley of Gilgal, beat him, and slew him.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Coriantumr and Shared may be shown fighting as Coriantumr defeats him.
unspecified_visual_details: Their appearance, weapons, and the method of Shared’s death are unspecified.

narration.text: Coriantumr gave Shared battle again in the valley of Gilgal, in which he beat Shared and slew him.

prohibited_inventions: Do not show gore, wounds, or severed body parts.
Do not invent other combatants or dialogue.

title: Coriantumr wounded
summary: Shared wounds Coriantumr in the thigh, preventing him from going to battle for two years. During that time bloodshed continues across the land without restraint.

explicit_facts.text: Shared wounded Coriantumr in the thigh, and Coriantumr did not go to battle for two years.
During those two years people throughout the land shed blood without anyone restraining them.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Coriantumr may be shown being wounded, without depicting the wound graphically.
unspecified_visual_details: The setting and manner of the injury are unspecified; the verse does not identify who restrained or failed to restrain the people.

narration.text: Shared wounded Coriantumr in his thigh
there was none to restrain them

doctrinal_or_story_notes: Coriantumr’s two-year absence and the widespread bloodshed are reported over time, not one simultaneous event.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict an invented restraint attempt or graphic injury.
